name: print-social-craft-fair-leaflet-maroon-with-zodiac-cards-and-tools
title: 'The Great American Craft Fair' leaflet on maroon with gold display type and two zodiac fact cards
whatItIs: A maroon-bordered leaflet with a bold gold-and-pink condensed 'THE GREAT AMERICAN CRAFT FAIR' title, a date and venue line, two colour-block fact cards ('Andromeda', 'Aquarius') explaining constellations, and a flat illustration of craft tools (glue, pins, a cutting mat, stamps) in the bottom corner.
whatItMeans: Warm and characterful; mixing astronomy trivia with craft tools suggests the fair itself has quirky, curious stallholders.
techniques: Pair two colour-block fact cards for quick trivia.
Use condensed display type in gold for a fairground feel.
Illustrate the event's actual tools and materials in one corner.

vocabulary.definition: A small block presenting a short piece of trivia or information.
Bold, decorative lettering meant for large headline use.
